name: l0_transition_state
about: Map-transition save state on sm_hub_1 (L0-r030). The global-entity table 0x106be530: DispatchSpawn 0x101d1280 adds a `globalname` entity on its first spawn (FUN_10057740 prepends: name[64], levelName[32] = the current map, state 1) and finds it (FUN_100576a0, case-insensitive) on a second spawn in the same map; CServerGameDLL slot 15 0x1011b040 -> FUN_10057a30 -> FUN_10057850 writes the GLOBAL header (m_listCount) and one GENT record per node, head first (CSave::vfunc3 always answers 1, so the result is 1); slot 16 0x1011b060 -> FUN_10057ac0 -> FUN_100578e0 clears the table, reads the header, zeroes the count and re-adds each record by prepending, so the restored order is the saved order reversed. Slot 23 BuildAdjacentMapList 0x1011b9f0 -> FUN_101c7ff0 over the map's 23 trigger_changelevels and 22 info_landmarks writes 23 ADJACENCY rows (FUN_101c7e00: Q_strncpy of map and landmark, the landmark edict, its origin) on the save, and with (oldLevel, landmarkName) = (sm_pawnshop_1, taxi_landmark) rewrites both triggers whose landmark is taxi_landmark (taxi_trigger `taxi`, to_downtown `la_hub_1`) to the level being left, so FUN_101c7e00 de-duplicates the second on (landmark edict, map): 22 rows. Slot 22 CreateEntityTransitionList 0x1011b590 -> FUN_101a3c40 over the saved entity table with mask bit 0: the one FENTTABLE_MOVEABLE row (the player's carried item; its bit 0 came from FUN_101c7ff0's second pass) is transferred -- flags := (0, 0x40000000), rc 1 -- then the four non-entity blocks' slot 7 with (adapter, 0, 0) and their slot 8; EntityPatchWrite 0x200973c0 lists the row in the `.HL3`. A mask naming no row (bit 23 of 23 transitions) moves nothing: no slot 7, the four slot 8 still run. Neither witness map authors globalname or env_global, so the two global entities are spawned by the record.

notes: Lump 0 of Unofficial_Patch/maps/sm_hub_1.bsp: the 23 trigger_changelevels in entity order are DinerTeleport1 (sm_diner_1 @ diner1), BailBondsTeleport1, JunkyardTeleport1, AsylumTeleport1, GalleryTeleport1, GalleryTeleport2, PawnshopTeleport1, HavenTeleport1, MedicalTeleport2, MedicalTeleport1, pierteleport1, BasementTeleport1, ApartmentTeleport1, warehouseteleport, taxi_trigger (taxi @ taxi_landmark), to_downtown (la_hub_1 @ taxi_landmark), transition, vamparenatransition, shreknetenter, sewer_map_trigger (sewer_map @ sewer_map_landmark), oceantrans, coffee_transition, smoke_transition (sm_smoke_1 @ smoke); every landmark resolves and the 23 (landmark, map) pairs are distinct. The GLOBAL group is one dword plus two 0x64-byte GENT records: 204 bytes. The carried item is the one FENTTABLE_MOVEABLE row (the recovered arms of the predicate are the player's carried set; the two +0xa8 arms are unrecovered, walk Open 6). The record's logic_relays carry FENTTABLE_GLOBAL and the transition bits but no destination copy answers for them at slot 22, so they are neither merged nor suppressed (the merge body FUN_101a3470 is unported: a reported planning fault).
